title: Parent and subagents across Claude and Codex
intro: Parents and subagents on two runtimes
Hosts start the subagents. Relay only carries the messages.
outro: Four registered peers, four mailboxes. Hosts created the subagents; Relay stored and handed out every message, and all of them polled.

captions.caption: Every agent AND subagent needs its own explicit peer binding.
Claude parent sends the task across runtimes through Relay.
Codex parent delegates to its own subagent, again through Relay.
Subagent result returns to its parent as a durable message.
The parent answers the Claude parent in the original conversation.
Claude parent fans work out to its own subagent.
Isolation: a subagent cannot acknowledge its parent's mail (0).
